name: Nyame / Onyankopon (Akan)

domain_history.domain: supreme being/creator; multiple praise-titles (Onyame, Onyankopon, Odomankoma, Borebore) used contextually, not fully interchangeable

notes: DISPUTED whether Nyame functions as a deus otiosus (withdrawn, non-interventionist after creation): Danquah's own reading treats Nyame as active/personally addressed; a general comparative-African-religion framing (and a reported, not directly verified, Geoffrey Parrinder reading closer to a first-ancestor figure) leans toward the withdrawn-god pattern — the Danquah/Parrinder disagreement itself is only verified via secondary summary, not primary texts, in this research pass.
